Name: Elliott Seasonal Portraits
Author: VeryFancy123
Description:
I made portraits for Elliott in the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. I used the New Handsome Elliott Portrait and Sprite by sabreene as the base and just changed the clothing to match that of the SO one. Sorry if they look off or bad, it's my first time doing this! All credits go to sabreene and their New Handsome Elliott Portrait and Sprite for allowing me to use their portraits as a base for this. I did get direct permission from sabreene to do this!

[b]How to install:
[list]
[*]Extract the zipped file.
[*]Move the assets folder into the Seasonal Cute Characters folder where the assets folder is located.
[*]It's going to say "This destination has 7 files with the same names"
[*]Press "Replace the files in this destination"
[/list][/b]
Please let me know if something isn't working.

[size=3]Credits Provided by sabreene:[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/158]Dreamburrows Elliott Portrait[/url] by DreamBurrow
This mod  was a huge inspiration, and was used as the base for the hair and eyes. I loved their take on the hair, and their blushy eyes! Basically the hair is a mesh of Dreamburrow's hair and Eemie's hair. The eyes were just tweaked slightly.  I haven't been able to reach Dreamburrows. If I hear from them and they would like the  hair and eyes changed, I will do so immediately!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/777]Front View Elliot [/url]by Eemie / Eemiestardew. (You should check out all her mods, if you haven't!!! I use sooo many of them in my game!!)
This mod helped me with the broader shoulders and clothes -- they were just slightly tweaked to fit the portrait better, and bottom side hair was used as well. It also gave me inspiration on how to draw the chiselled jaw.  It is with her authorization that I've made the "Vintage" Elliott!
